speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To understand the cause of your double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness, please tell me: do you experience any difficulty swallowing or breathing?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening weakness with activity and improvement with rest, along with diplopia on vertical gaze, strongly suggests myasthenia gravis. To confirm this, I need to check your specific antibody levels: REQUEST TEST: Anti-AChR and Anti-MuSK antibodies. Do you also have a history of any eye infections or surgeries?
